entries.name: v1-ext-tuple-height-evaluated-reject#0
entries.description: Input 0's extension is {0: Tuple(1, HEIGHT)} (86 02 04 02 a3), which parses, and the spent tree is sigmaProp(true) (00 d1 01 01), which is evaluated. toSigmaContext converts every extension value before the script runs (ErgoLikeContext.scala:158-161): Tuple.value casts each item to EvaluatedValue with an assert (values.scala:819), and HEIGHT fails it: an AssertionError, although the script never reads the variable. Invalid. An impl that converts lazily, or not at all, accepts. The input spends a box of value 1000000000 into one output of the same value, with no proof.

expected.reason: org.ergoplatform.validation.MalformedModifierError: Scripts of all transaction inputs should pass verification. da95922af81e5a76cc0618cf3192ed0ad2f3232da6bc357e43ab415f94d1da16: #0 => Failure(java.lang.AssertionError: assertion failed: Value Height$(163) doesn't conform to type sigma.ast.EvaluatedValue)

entries.name: v2-ext-tuple-height-sigmaprop-root-accept#1
entries.description: The same extension, but the spent tree is the SigmaProp constant TrueProp (00 08 d3): a SigmaPropConstant root is never evaluated (Interpreter.scala:210-217), so nothing is converted. Valid. The input spends a box of value 1000000000 into one output of the same value, with no proof.

entries.name: v3-ext-tuple-node-as-pair-reject#2
entries.description: Input 0's extension is {0: Tuple(1, 2)} as a Tuple node (86 02 04 02 04 04); the script is sigmaProp(getVar[(Int, Int)](0).get._1 == 1). The node's value is a Coll[Any], but stypeToRType of a 2-item STuple is a pair type (Evaluation.scala:37-40), so getVar hands the evaluator a Coll where a pair is typed, and its type check throws ('Invalid type returned by evaluator', values.scala:233-248). Invalid. An impl that reads the node as a real pair accepts. The input spends a box of value 1000000000 into one output of the same value, with no proof.

  expression: OptionGet(GetVar(0,Option[(SInt$,SInt$)]))
  expected type: (SInt$,SInt$)
  resulting value: Coll(1,2)

entries.name: v7-ext-tuple-three-accept#7
entries.description: Input 0's extension is {0: a 3-item Tuple (1, 2, 3)} (86 03 04 02 04 04 04 06), and the spent tree is sigmaProp(true), evaluated. toSigmaContext converts every extension value before the script runs (ErgoLikeContext.scala:158-161), and a Tuple of any arity converts (Evaluation.scala:41-48). entries.name: v8-rent-var127-trueleaf-script-accept#8
entries.description: Storage rent: the spent box (sigmaProp(true)) was created at height 0, so it is rent-eligible at H; the proof is empty and var 127 is TrueLeaf (7f). The rent path's Short cast throws inside its Try, so verify falls back to the script (ErgoInterpreter.scala:77-84), which accepts. The output is created at H - 1, which a recreation would violate. Valid.

entries.name: v8-rent-var127-trueleaf-p2pk-reject#9
entries.description: The same rent-eligible spend of a P2PK box: the fallback verifies the script, which needs a proof, and the proof is empty. Invalid.

entries.name: v9-r4-tuple-node-as-pair-reject#10
entries.description: The spent box's R4 is Tuple(1, 2) as a Tuple node (86 02 04 02 04 04); the script is sigmaProp(SELF.R4[(Int, Int)].get._1 == 1). Registers convert like extension values (CBox.scala:77-94): the node's value is a Coll typed as a pair, and the evaluator's type check throws. Invalid. An impl that reads the node as a real pair accepts. The input spends a box of value 1000000000 into one output of the same value, with no proof.

entries.name: v10-r4-tuple-height-read-r5-reject#12
entries.description: The spent box's R4 is Tuple(1, HEIGHT) (86 02 04 02 a3) and R5 is Int 1; the script is sigmaProp(SELF.R5[Int].get == 1). The box's registers convert all at once on its first register read (CBox.scala:28), so reading R5 converts R4 too, and HEIGHT fails Tuple.value's assert. Invalid. An impl that converts registers one at a time accepts. The input spends a box of value 1000000000 into one output of the same value, with no proof.
